objective: Prove the frozen target (W): the reduction (R') for the 2n-pigeon principle, the spare-row lemma (S) by a cube with hole coordinates, and the density count (D), giving exp(c n/l^5) lines for every dag-like Res(xor) refutation of WLP_{2n} and of LP_{n+1}.
status: Proof written 2026-11-10 (V1, not independently checked, conditional on A55; under audit AUDIT-LEFT-20261110-001): every dag-like Res(xor) refutation of the binary left-pigeon principle with 2n pigeons, and so of the PPADS-complete one with n + 1 (a clause subset), has 3S + 2n^2(l+1) >= exp(0.005 k/l^2 - 1), k = floor(n/(64 l^3)).
title: A dag-like Res(xor) lower bound for the binary left-pigeon principle
